roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital role offers an opportunity to significantly impact patient care and staff competency within a supportive environment. If you are passionate about education and maintaining high standards of health and safety, we encourage you to apply.

In this dual role, you will be responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive staff education programs, ensuring our team is equipped with the latest knowledge and skills. Concurrently, you will lead our infection prevention and control initiatives, safeguarding the well-being of residents and staff through robust policies and practices. Your expertise will be crucial in fostering a culture of continuous learning and clinical excellence.

This full-time position offers a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42. Join a team committed to providing exceptional care and professional growth. Apply today to learn more about this exciting opportunity.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Minimum of 2-3 years of nursing experience, preferably in long-term care or skilled nursing
Proven experience in staff education, training, or development
Strong understanding and practical experience in infection prevention and control
Knowledge of current state and federal healthcare regulations
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation is $40-$42 per hour, based on experience.
